title: Kókborokma (Classical Kokborok Grammar)
author: Radhamohan Debbarma Thakur & Doulot Ahmad
description: The historic, pioneering foundational grammar of the Kokborok language commissioned under the royal patronage of Maharaja Radha Kishore Manikya.
